# 1.0.9 beta 1

This beta supersedes 1.0.8 beta 1 and adds the guided Linux setup, release explorer, installation
history, notification center and the latest installer accessibility and workflow improvements.

- Added a nine-step first-run setup wizard covering Titanfall 2, the Linux backend, Proton and
  dependencies, OpenXR, WiVRn, Steam and release selection. Configured steps are skipped
  automatically, and the wizard can be reopened from Settings.
- Added a dedicated installation history page with operation type, previous and new version,
  channel, result, backend commit, duration, exit code, linked log content and filters for installs,
  updates, reinstalls, repairs and uninstalls.
- Added a release explorer with version search, Stable/Beta/Pinned filters, sortable release cards,
  exact per-release changelogs, installed and selected markers, and side-by-side comparison.
- Added a notification center with unread counts and persistent entries for completed installs,
  failures, new stable and beta releases, helper updates, Steam integration and WiVRn desktop-entry
  issues.
- Added contextual help popovers beside release channels, pinned releases, Proton, WiVRn, Steam
  restart and rebuild controls.
- Added Compact and Comfortable layout density, remembered details-panel state, copy buttons for
  versions and paths, searchable operation logs, install confirmation previews, clearer empty
  states and accessible control names.
- Added interface and technical-text font selection, including a technical-output preview and
  fallbacks when a saved system font is no longer available.
- Added a title-bar busy indicator so long-running install, update and backend operations remain
  visible while the installer is working.
- Fixed changelog comparisons so a release without notes shows the localized unavailable message
  instead of a fake added line; the display placeholder is never treated as changelog content.
- Expanded all ten interface catalogs to 544 keys and updated the localization glossary.
- Existing settings migrate to schema 8, preserving earlier appearance, integration and update
  preferences. Automated coverage is now 140 Core tests.

The installer archive remains self-contained, checksum-verified and installable without root.
